sessionName: one session, eighty minutes — lighter than Week A

ops.title: Oven on, two trays
ops.body: 200 °C fan. Two trays lined. Week B is a lighter prep than Week A — one roast, one stew, one batch of koftas, and rice.

ops.title: Tray A — the week's chicken
ops.body: 760 g chicken breast, salt, garlic powder, onion powder. Nothing else, again. 28 min for a tray this size. It carries Monday's fried rice, Tuesday's salad and Friday's club sandwich.

ops.title: Pan 1 — turkey and okra stew
ops.body: 90 g red onion and 160 g red pepper into oil, 5 min. 280 g turkey mince broken up and browned, 5 min. 260 g passata, 200 ml stock, thyme, a pinch of stock powder, scotch bonnet. 12 min. Then 270 g okra in for the LAST 5 MINUTES ONLY.

ops.title: Tray B — the koftas
ops.body: 255 g 5% beef mince with 40 g grated onion squeezed dry, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, dried mint, salt, pepper. Worked hard for a minute, then shaped into 6 fingers. 18 min.

ops.title: Eggs on
ops.body: 6 medium eggs, 8 minutes in boiling water, straight into cold. Peel now. Five are Tuesday's snack across the two of you; the spare gets eaten.

ops.title: Koftas out
ops.body: Cooled on a rack, then straight into the FREEZER in one bag. Sunday to Thursday is too long in the fridge for cooked mince — move them down to the fridge on Wednesday night.

ops.title: Pan 3 — the rice
ops.body: 380 g brown rice, dry, plain. 25 min. This covers Monday's fried rice, Tuesday's dinner and Wednesday's lunch — and stops there. Friday's rice is cooked fresh inside the dish.

ops.title: Chicken out
ops.body: Rested 5 minutes. Left whole rather than sliced — it dries out far more slowly that way, and Friday is a long way off.

ops.title: Rice the cauliflower
ops.body: One large head, about 810 g riced. Pulse it, don't run the processor — couscous, not paste. Stored RAW; it cooks in three minutes at the plate.

ops.title: Two jars
ops.body: SUYA: 3 parts ground roasted peanut to 1 part chilli, plus ginger, garlic powder and stock powder. It appears on Wednesday dinner (rub, dip and finishing dust) and Friday's carrot snack. CHILLI SALT: 2 parts flaky salt to 1 part chilli flakes, briefly ground together.

ops.title: Rice off — cool it fast
ops.body: Spread thin on a cold tray, into the fridge within the hour. Same rule as Week A and the same reason: slowly-cooled rice is the classic way to make yourself ill.

ops.title: Portion, label, and check the freezer
ops.body: Boxes marked with the day. Then look ahead: Tuesday needs 370 g basa or tilapia and Friday needs 255 g salmon. If they're frozen, they need moving down in good time.

midweek.heading: Monday night
midweek.body: Make the overnight oats — 4 minutes. Oats, skyr, chia, cinnamon, water and half the grated apple into a jar. It is the only dish this week that has to be started the day before.

midweek.heading: Kept raw on purpose
midweek.body: Wednesday's suya skewers use raw chicken, not Sunday's roast — 305 g of it, cubed on the night. Roast chicken on a skewer is a sad thing.

midweek.heading: Tuesday
midweek.body: Basa or tilapia bought fresh, or moved down from the freezer on Monday night. Escovitch wants fish that has never been near a reheat.

midweek.heading: Wednesday night
midweek.body: Koftas from the freezer to the fridge. Friday's salmon down too if it's frozen — 255 g, for the teriyaki.
